# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.84

This corrective release restores direct Android update compatibility with the
BlockBuddies v1.5.79 APK.

## Fixed

- Signed the APK with the exact private key used for v1.5.79.
- Restored the v1.5.79 signer certificate fingerprint:
  `ab79aba264ecc6b80736355d1835179ddab9f3c91d8d1d4c85a9292942aad19c`.
- Added a release-pipeline check that fails the build if the APK signer ever
  changes unexpectedly.
- Kept the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline` and app label
  `BlockBuddies`.

## Update instructions

- If v1.5.79 is installed, v1.5.84 can update it directly without uninstalling.
- v1.5.82 and v1.5.83 used a different temporary certificate. If either of
  those versions is installed, uninstall it once before installing v1.5.84.
- After installing v1.5.84, future releases from this workflow will use the same
  v1.5.79-compatible signing key and update normally.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.84.apk`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- `SIGNING-CERTIFICATE.txt`
- `APK-BADGING.txt`

## Validation

- Exact signer-certificate comparison against the v1.5.79 APK
- Package-name and app-label checks
- ESLint and Oxlint
- TypeScript type checking
- Vitest unit and component tests
- Production web build
- Capacitor Android sync and release APK assembly

The matching keystore is stored as an encrypted GitHub Actions secret and is
never committed to the repository or uploaded as a release asset.
